# `virgo.pdf`

Fixture for `test_mineru_path_indexes_table_values_as_text`
(tests/test_pdf_subsystem.py, nexus-jd8fi). The test asserts that MinerU
extracts Table 1 on page 15 ("Threat Model and Mitigations in Private Virtual
Tree Networks") as text, including the cells "Replay Attack" and "Nonce or
timestamp binding".

## Source

Lican Huang, "Private Virtual Tree Networks for Secure Multi-Tenant
Environments Based on the VIRGO Overlay Network", arXiv:2512.15915v1
[cs.CR], 17 Dec 2025. Also Journal of Advances in Information Science and
Technology, 3(2), pp. 1-19, December 2025.
